subject: Security exhibit: finalize pen-test scope, SOC 2 evidence cadence, and MSA wording
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: security@veridianhealth.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit: finalize pen-test scope, SOC 2 evidence cadence, and MSA wording

Hi Dana,

Thanks again for taking time yesterday. Per our conversation, attaching the current security exhibit (MSA appendix) and a short proposal for a lightweight evidence cadence that keeps your auditors satisfied while limiting operational churn on our side. High-level asks from your team that we want to address:

- Clarify pen-test access window and scope (prod vs. staging)
- SOC 2 evidence types and a cadence for sharing attestations and control logs
- Concrete acceptance language for limited inspection/inspection-lite vs. full forensic access

Proposals inline in the attached doc, but the key points we plan to put forward:

1) Pen-test: 14-day rolling notice for scheduled pen-tests; scoped to staging environment by default, with production windowed and timeboxed if requested (we will provide ephemeral read-only credentials and a single point-of-contact).

2) SOC 2: provide latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where required) within 5 business days of executed order form; weekly evidence snapshots for 4 weeks post-onboarding (S3 manifest + sample logs).

3) Audit rights: preferentially pursue an "inspection-lite" flow: document package + limited observation rather than full on-site access. If a full inspection is required, it will be scoped, scheduled, and subject to an NDA + agreed remediation backlog/timebox.

If we can get your initial redlines, we'll produce a counterproposal and suggest a 30-minute legal/infosec sync to land final wording.

Attaching: proposed exhibit + sample pen-test statement.

Cheers,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Reliability Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- proposed_security_exhibit_v1.docx (attached)
- pen-test-stmt-proposed.docx (attached)
From: Dana P. <security@veridianhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@veridianhealth.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit: finalize pen-test scope, SOC 2 evidence cadence, and MSA wording

Marcus —

Thanks for the note and attachments. We reviewed with infosec and legal and attached our redlines to the security exhibit (see Veridian_redlines_security_exhibit.docx). Key comments:

- SOC 2: we need an explicit commitment to provide SOC 2 Type II for the most recent 12-month period within 10 business days of request; a promise to notify within 30 days if an adverse control finding appears is required.

- Pen-test: we appreciate staging by default but require the ability to request a production test once per 12 months with at least 21 days notice; production tests must be coordinated and executed during pre-approved maintenance windows.

- Audit rights: our legal team flags that the "inspection-lite" language is OK only if there is a clause for escalation to deeper inspection in the event of suspected data compromise. We included escalation criteria.

We also attached the SOC2 report summary (SOC2-TypeII-2025.pdf) for your review — note that the report contains vendor-supplied redactions.

We can do a quick call Thursday 10–10:30am PT to work through items and close the order form.

Dana P.
Director, Security Operations
Veridian Health

Attachments:
- Veridian_redlines_security_exhibit.docx (attached)
- SOC2-TypeII-2025.pdf (attached)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit: finalize pen-test scope, SOC 2 evidence cadence, and MSA wording

On Tue, Sep 28, 2026 at 12:40 PM Dana P. <security@veridianhealth.com> wrote:
> Marcus —
> 
> Thanks for the note and attachments. We reviewed with infosec and legal and attached our redlines to the security exhibit...

Thanks Dana and team for the quick turn. Marcus / Laura — my read and recommended redlines:

1) SOC 2 turnaround: we can commit to providing the latest SOC 2 Type II within 7 business days (we keep the report on S3 for customer download; 10 days is fine if legal prefers). We will add a notification commit for material control failures (we'll caveat "material and verified" and add an internal remediation window).

2) Pen-test: we prefer staging by default and can accept a single production test per 12 months. Counterproposal: 21 days notice for production tests is reasonable, but we want the test to be during a mutually agreed 8-hour window (we'll propose maintenance windows). We will also require that testing is non-destructive and that a rollback plan is provided.

3) Audit rights escalation: accept escalation clause with explicit triggers (e.g., confirmed data breach, systemic control failure). Add language limiting privilege elevation and requiring a scoped statement of work and an NDA for forensic access.

Action plan: I'll prepare a redline counter (MSA_exhibit_redline_v2) and propose a 30m sync with Veridian legal to accept/adjust. Marcus — can you confirm availability for Thu 10–10:30 PT (Dana suggested slot) and whether we want Laura on the call for legal signoff?

—Karthik

Attachments referenced: MSA_exhibit_redline_v2.docx (draft)
From: Dana P. <security@veridianhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: legal@veridianhealth.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security exhibit: finalize pen-test scope, SOC 2 evidence cadence, and MSA wording

Marcus / Karthik —

Thanks for the quick responses and the proposed counter language. Thu 10am PT works for us; please send a calendar invite and attach the draft redline you want us to review before the call.

A few clarifications we will expect on the call so we can greenlight the order form:

- Confirmed SOC 2 delivery SLA (we prefer 10 business days but can accept 7 if operationally guaranteed).
- Clear definition of "staging" vs. "production" environments and what artifacts will be available in each environment for testing (logs, eti, ephemeral credentials).
- Pen-test signoff: evidence package and remediation SLAs (we will want a 30-day remediation plan for high-severity findings).
- Evidence cadence: sample weekly snapshot (first 4 weeks) plus a rolling 90-day log retention manifest accessible via secure S3 link.

We'll review Karthik's redline and the SOC2 summary before the call and come with a short list of non-starters (if any). Looking forward to aligning.

Thanks,
Dana
Director, Security Operations
Veridian Health
